financial_trends.evidence: Quarterly INR revenue grew from 70,698 cr in Q4 FY26 to 72,275 cr in Q1 FY27 (+2.23% QoQ) and 73,188 cr in Q2 FY27 (+1.26% QoQ). However, constant-currency (CC) QoQ growth moderated from 1.2% in Q4 FY26 to 0.4% in Q1 FY27 and 0.5% in Q2 FY27, reflecting softer sequential volume momentum despite positive YoY CC growth of 2.8% in Q2 FY27.

Operating margin fell from 25.28% in Q4 FY26 to 23.96% in Q1 FY27 (-132 bps QoQ) following annual wage hikes, which raised employee costs from 56.78% of revenue to 58.30%. In Q2 FY27, operating margin remained largely flat at 23.98% (+2 bps QoQ) despite employee cost dropping to 57.24%, as third-party costs and growth investments absorbed efficiency gains.

Net profit increased modestly from 13,718 cr in Q4 FY26 to 13,849 cr in Q1 FY27 (+0.95% QoQ) and 13,884 cr in Q2 FY27 (+0.25% QoQ). Net margin moved from 19.40% in Q4 FY26 to 19.16% in Q1 FY27 and 18.97% in Q2 FY27, indicating steady absolute profit generation alongside minor margin compression.

Order book TCV normalized from $12.0bn in Q4 FY26 to $9.5bn in Q1 FY27 and $9.6bn in Q2 FY27. Headcount grew by 9,279 in Q1 FY27 and 4,258 in Q2 FY27 to reach 598,056, while LTM attrition steadily improved from 13.7% in Q4 FY26 to 13.6% in Q1 FY27 and 13.3% in Q2 FY27. Cash flow conversion (CFO/Net Profit) remained healthy at 102.2% in Q2 FY27.

management_outlook.summary: Management maintains a cautiously optimistic stance. CEO K Krithivasan highlighted that major client-specific headwinds are largely behind the company and expressed confidence in medium-term growth momentum grounded in strong TCV ($9.5B-$9.6B quarterly), robust pipelines, and rapidly scaling AI revenue ($3.1B annualized in Q2 FY27). CFO Samir Seksaria acknowledged near-term margin friction from annual wage increments in Q1 FY27, ecosystem growth investments, normal H2 furlough seasonality, and ~50 bps expected dilution from the MHP acquisition, while reiterating focus on disciplined execution to gradually improve margins over time.

key_quotes.text: By and large, most of the headwinds we know probably are behind us, excepting few that may come up or that we have already accounted for.
key_quotes.speaker: K Krithivasan

key_quotes.text: On the wage increments, you should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.
key_quotes.speaker: Samir Seksaria

key_quotes.text: However, our outlook remains positive for manufacturing based on multiple net new deal wins signed this quarter.
key_quotes.speaker: K Krithivasan

key_quotes.text: looking at all the parameters, I don't want to comment on the immediate next quarter basis, but on a medium-term basis, looking at the TCV, looking at the pipeline and the client conversations that we are having, we're confident that growth momentum will continue.
key_quotes.speaker: K Krithivasan

key_quotes.text: The acquisition-related dilution, particularly in MHP, is likely to impact by about 50 basis points depending on the timing of closure and when the integration starts. The normal furlough seasonality and our continued ecosystem investments would be our headwinds.
key_quotes.speaker: Samir Seksaria

key_quotes.text: While it's an uphill task, we'll continue to endeavor to inch up on our margins.
key_quotes.speaker: Samir Seksaria

risks.title: Seasonal Year-End Furloughs and Working Day Impact
risks.detail: Q3 typically experiences client year-end furloughs and fewer billable working days, creating seasonal growth drag across North America and Europe.
risks.source: Q2 FY27 earnings call, Samir Seksaria

risks.title: MHP Acquisition Margin Dilution
risks.detail: The closing and integration of the MHP acquisition is expected to dilute operating margins by approximately 50 basis points in the second half of the fiscal year.
risks.source: Q2 FY27 earnings call, Samir Seksaria

risks.title: Macro Caution and Discretionary Spend Scrutiny
risks.detail: Clients remain cautious on non-essential discretionary projects, with heightened scrutiny on return on investment in verticals like Communications, Media & Information (CMI) and Consumer Products.
risks.source: Q2 FY27 earnings call, K Krithivasan

risks.title: Subcontractor and Strategic Investment Overhead
risks.detail: Elevated third-party vendor/subcontractor expenses and strategic ecosystem/SG&A investments continue to put pressure on gross margins.
risks.source: Q2 FY27 earnings call, Samir Seksaria

opportunities.title: Rapid Scaling of AI Revenue and Agentic AI Deployments
opportunities.detail: Annualized AI revenue accelerated to $3.1 billion in Q2 FY27 (crossing 10% of total revenue), up from $2.3 billion in Q4 FY26, driven by scaling GenAI, enterprise transformation, and agentic AI adoption across application and infrastructure portfolios.
opportunities.source: Q2 FY27 earnings call, K Krithivasan

opportunities.title: Large Net-New Deal Wins and Transformation Mandates
opportunities.detail: Secured major transformation engagements including a landmark $800M global AI-led transformation deal with SKF in Q1 FY27 and key partnerships with Best Buy and ABB, highlighting competitive strength in large-scale programs.
opportunities.source: Q1 FY27 earnings call, K Krithivasan

opportunities.title: Workforce Addition and Steady Attrition Improvement
opportunities.detail: Headcount grew by 4,258 in Q2 FY27 to 598,056 while LTM attrition steadily moderated to 13.3%, strengthening delivery capacity for ramping deal wins.

opportunities.title: Strong Cash Generation and Operational Discipline
opportunities.detail: Consistently robust cash flow conversion, with CFO to Net Profit reaching 102.2% in Q2 FY27 (and 106.7% in Q4 FY26), reinforcing financial stability and balance sheet strength.

forecast.revenue_outlook: Revenue in Q3 FY27 is expected to show flat to modestly positive low-single-digit constant-currency QoQ growth. Growth will be supported by ongoing deal ramp-ups and enterprise AI adoption ($3.1B annualized AI revenue), but constrained by seasonal client year-end furloughs and fewer billable working days.
forecast.margin_outlook: Operating margin is expected to face mild downward pressure to range-bound movement in Q3 FY27. Primary headwinds include seasonal furloughs, lower working days, strategic ecosystem/AI investments, and an estimated ~50 bps dilution from the MHP acquisition integration, partially offset by ongoing operational discipline.
forecast.overall_outlook: TCS enters Q3 FY27 backed by solid medium-term deal wins and accelerating AI revenue, which has exceeded 10% of total revenue. However, typical H2 seasonality—specifically Q3 client year-end furloughs—alongside integration dilution from the MHP acquisition will constrain top-line acceleration and margin expansion. Overall, Q3 FY27 is projected to show resilient operational execution with steady absolute revenue and minor margin compression.
